name: Evergreen anytime proration (partial periods + transient end date)
expected: An Evergreen line with AllowPartialProrationPeriods=true and a mid-period itemTransientEndDate enters V21 step 45 'Evergreen anytime proration filter (Line level)' / ListOperation83 (SellingModelType='Evergreen' AND AllowPartialProrationPeriods=true AND itemTransientEndDate IsNotNull), and the gated Proration BKM computes a fractional (anytime/mid-period) ProrationMultiplier -> PricingTermCount against the transient end date, so ItemNetTotalPrice = NetUnitPrice * Qty * proratedTermCount.
actual: Scenario is un-instantiable in FortraUAT. Catalog has ZERO Evergreen sellable config: ProductSellingModelOption GROUP BY SellingModelType returns ONLY TermDefined=4944 and OneTime=3939 (0 Evergreen PSMOs); 0 active Evergreen PricebookEntry in any book; 0 Evergreen Assets; 0 existing Evergreen QuoteLineItem/OrderItem. The 4 Evergreen ProductSellingModel records (0jPWC00000006C92AI Monthly / ...CA Quarterly / ...CB Semi-Annual / ...CC Yearly) exist but no Product2 is mapped to them, so no priceable Evergreen line can be built. Moreover the two gating context attributes are NOT stored fields: FieldDefinition search for '%Transient%' = 0 rows and '%PartialProration%' = 0 rows. AllowPartialProrationPeriods is derived from ProrationPolicy.ArePartialPeriodsAllowed (Default Proration Policy 0mua50000004KzRAAU has it =true, so cond#2 is reachable), but itemTransientEndDate is a platform-derived transient runtime value (the partial-period boundary computed by the proration engine during a mid-period amendment/co-term/anytime change of an EXISTING Evergreen subscription). A fresh quote line gets EndDate=Start+term (full period), never a transient mid-period end date, and itemTransientEndDate is not a settable input on the place/reprice API. With 0 Evergreen Assets to amend, cond#3 (itemTransientEndDate IsNotNull) cannot be satisfied by any record buildable under validation constraints.

Org queries (FortraUAT, api v67): PSMO GROUP BY SellingModelType -> {TermDefined:4944, OneTime:3939} (0 Evergreen); PBE WHERE SellingModelType='Evergreen' -> 0; Asset Evergreen -> 0; QLI/OI Evergreen -> 0; ProrationPolicy: 0mua50000004KzRAAU 'Default Proration Policy' ArePartialPeriodsAllowed=true; FieldDefinition LIKE '%Transient%' -> 0 rows, LIKE '%PartialProration%' -> 0 rows.
proposedFix: Not a defect; nothing to fix in V21 (the gating ListOperation83 and child Proration BKM are wired exactly to spec). To make this scenario testable would require config work outside validation scope: (1) create an Evergreen ProductSellingModelOption on a Product2 mapped to one of the 4 existing Evergreen PSMs and an active Evergreen PricebookEntry (>0 list, matching currency) in the active Fortra Price Book - note RLM-managed catalog DML + PSMO<->PBE interlock constraints; (2) order/activate that Evergreen line to produce an active Evergreen Asset; (3) perform a mid-period amendment/co-term/anytime change so the platform proration engine derives itemTransientEndDate. Only then will ListOperation83 fire and the anytime proration be observable. Recommend deferring B-05 until an Evergreen catalog exists in FortraUAT, or moving it to a sandbox seeded with Evergreen products.
notes: Static trace of the V21 branch is CLEAN and matches proc_mechanism verbatim (ListOperation83 three-condition guard + Proration BKM prorating to itemTransientEndDate via PricingTermUnit, output to PricingTermCount). Preflight FAILS at the very first gate: no Evergreen product/PBE/asset/line exists and itemTransientEndDate cannot be populated on a buildable record. Per the method brief anti-phantom-defect doctrine, an un-instantiable scenario is BLOCKED with the exact blocker, never a fabricated PASS and never FAIL (the procedure was never exercised on valid inputs). rootCause=TEST-DATA-ARTIFACT (the test_setup presupposes an Evergreen catalog + transient end date that FortraUAT does not and cannot cheaply provide), defect_provenance=none/catalog-derived. Sibling B-01/B-02/B-03 (One-Time, TermDefined annual, tiered subscription) all PASSED on real data; Evergreen is the one selling model with no Fortra catalog footprint.
verdict_reason: The Evergreen anytime-proration branch cannot be exercised: FortraUAT has zero Evergreen catalog (0 PSMOs/PBEs/assets/lines; only TermDefined+OneTime) and itemTransientEndDate is a non-stored, platform-derived transient value that only appears on a mid-period amendment of an existing Evergreen subscription, so cond#3 of ListOperation83 is unreachable - preflight fails before any pricing run, so the verdict is BLOCKED.
